title: PS5 forwarder, forwarder.json, format version 1
description: What a forwarder tile starts. See SPEC.md, section 2.

format.description: The format version. Writers set it; readers accept its absence (forwarders from before the standard).

target.description: The title ID of the app to start.

args.description: Launch arguments passed to the target, in order. At most 4096 bytes in all, counting a NUL after each.

creator.description: What made the forwarder, for display and support.

rom.description: Before the standard: the --rom argument. Readers accept it; writers do not write it.

exit_after_game.description: Before the standard: the --exit-after-game argument. Readers accept it; writers do not write it.
